responsibility: This subtarget header applies Microsoft ABI conventions to the AArch64 backend, overriding the generic port’s register and calling-sequence assumptions for Windows-style targets. In particular it reserves `x18` for the thread environment block, marks it non-call-clobbered, and moves the nested-function static chain to `x17`, so later prologue/epilogue generation, register allocation, and call expansion use the ABI-required hard-register assignments.
